title: Layout of an embedded configuration
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine on input $x$, and let $ct:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)$ and $cp\in\mathbb Z$. Embedding $c$ into the first $k$ tapes of a machine with one additional tape, assigning the additional tape content $ct$ and head position $cp$, and leaving the output prefix empty, gives exactly the clock configuration with state $c$'s state and additional tape $(ct,cp)$.
